errors.evidence: The x-axis represents a time period in years, with labels for hundreds of thousands of years (e.g., 800,000, 700,000), not millions of years.
The tick marks on the x-axis are spaced at intervals of 100,000 years, not millions of years.

errors.text_span: е етикетирана „Текущо ниво на въглероден диоксид (ppm)“
errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled 'Ниво на СО2 (ppm)' (Level of CO2 (ppm)). 'Текущо ниво' (Current level) is a label for the final data point on the graph, not the axis label.
The numbers on the y-axis are spaced at intervals of 50 (e.g., 160, 210, 260, 310), not 20.
The figure is a line chart, not a bar chart ('стълбовидно множество').

errors.text_span: Най-ниската стойност, отбелязана на диаграмата, е около 260 ppm
errors.evidence: The lowest value on the chart is approximately 230 ppm (at around 700,000, 500,000, and 100,000 years). The value of 260 ppm is the starting point at 800,000 years.

This repeats the error of identifying the chart as a bar chart ('стълбовиден график') instead of a line chart. The word 'трептящ' (vibrating/flickering) is also inappropriate for describing the visual.
